decision: Standing user choice for this run: every rule that clears the precision gate enters the queue, nothing is deferred. All three rules scored pattern_precision 1.0 with status PASS and queue_eligible true in 01.5-precision-report.json (CORBA_REMOVAL 60/60 judged out of a 333-hit population, TLS_ANON_CIPHER_DISABLED 2/2 census, CLDR_LOCALE_DATA_DEFAULT 5/5 census). CORBA_REMOVAL (HIGH) and TLS_ANON_CIPHER_DISABLED (MEDIUM) are mandatory breaking changes; CLDR_LOCALE_DATA_DEFAULT (LOW) is queued rather than deferred under the same standing choice. The on-disk order here is by severity; the binding execution order is computed by effective_rule_order, which ranks body-local ahead of signature, so the two body-local rules run before CORBA_REMOVAL.
